method: Compare each mesh by name; triangulate source and imported mesh, match triangles via sorted world-position corners rounded to 1e-5 model units; compare corresponding per-loop UV pairs in that corner order, independent of vertex/index reorder. All UV layers compared by layer index; names recorded but not required. Duplicate spatial triangles matched to nearest unused UV tuple.
scope: UV data round-trip only. Does not validate source imagery, texture quality, material appearance, or hidden geometry.
